title: METAPHYSICAL ANTHROPOLOGY
modules: On The Concept Of The Soul
African Notions Of Soul (Yoruba And Akan)
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means to blow or to cool and hence refers to breath, life, soul, spirit or consciousness."
The Greek word psyche means to blow or to cool and hence refers to breath, life, soul, spirit or consciousness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the higher soul which distinguishes man from all other life forms."
Neshamah is the higher soul which distinguishes man from all other life forms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the final end of everything. (Schumacher, 2010) At death, the body decomposes and ceases to exist."
Materialists therefore argue that death/mortality is the final end of everything. (Schumacher, 2010) At death, the body decomposes and ceases to exist.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool that examines the logical features of predication and of the various theories of universals."
Formal ontology is a tool that examines the logical features of predication and of the various theories of universals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an unavoidable bitter reality of life."
Death is an unavoidable bitter reality of life.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the world's oldest religious traditions, and it is founded upon what is often regarded as the oldest surviving text of humanity: the Vedas."
Hinduism is one of the world's oldest religious traditions, and it is founded upon what is often regarded as the oldest surviving text of humanity: the Vedas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systematic study of human as a biological organism."
Physical anthropology is the systematic study of human as a biological organism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the immediate forerunner of the English word 'individual'."
Individualism is the immediate forerunner of the English word 'individual'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a perennial topic in metaphysics."
The nature of Being is a perennial topic in metaphysics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dissolution of separate "inner selves" reflected in the defense mechanisms that defend ego against threats to self-worth."
Integration is the dissolution of separate "inner selves" reflected in the defense mechanisms that defend ego against threats to self-worth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of three parts namely ara, emi and ori."
The Yoruba believe that a person is made up of three parts namely ara, emi and ori.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with man and his existence in the universe."
Ontology is concerned with man and his existence in the universe.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the spokesmen for Yoruba's idea of personhood and community."
Segun Gbadegesin is one of the spokesmen for Yoruba's idea of personhood and community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the physical/material aspect which perishes at death while the spirit and the soul are immaterial aspects which survive after death."
The body is the physical/material aspect which perishes at death while the spirit and the soul are immaterial aspects which survive after death.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a result of the visitation of the malevolent forces when an entity fails to conform to the ideal of order which is signified chiefly by Olodumare."
Evil is a result of the visitation of the malevolent forces when an entity fails to conform to the ideal of order which is signified chiefly by Olodumare.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a field of study which studies man and his behaviour."
Anthropology can be defined as a field of study which studies man and his behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the various ways that people can be classified on the basis of their occupation."
Social class refers to the various ways that people can be classified on the basis of their occupation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the branch of anthropology that studies material remains usually from the past to explain and describe human behaviour."
Archeology is the branch of anthropology that studies material remains usually from the past to explain and describe human behaviour.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the formal cause of growth and metabolism and is shared by plants, while the perceptual psyche gives rise to desire, which causes self-moving animals to act."
The nutritive psyche is the formal cause of growth and metabolism and is shared by plants, while the perceptual psyche gives rise to desire, which causes self-moving animals to act.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as one of the world best known and most widely read philosophers."
Plato's Biography Plato is regarded as one of the world best known and most widely read philosophers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to list the fundamental constituents of reality."
An ontological catalogue is an attempt to list the fundamental constituents of reality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a 'status' conferred on a biological person upon acquiring the 'substances' as defined by human community."
Personhood is a 'status' conferred on a biological person upon acquiring the 'substances' as defined by human community.
